verdict.description: The verdicts the critic MODEL may emit. PASS = no substantive issues against the ruler. ISSUES = substantive gaps found. BLOCKED = cannot judge (needs context only the human has). Note: UNABLE_TO_REVIEW is a seam-only state emitted by critic.sh on system failure (it bypasses this schema) — the model must never return it; use BLOCKED instead.

issues.description: Populated only when verdict is ISSUES; otherwise null.

ruler_item.description: Which ruler checklist item this violates.

location.description: Where in the artifact the gap is — section number or requirement id (file:line in code mode). Null if it applies to the whole artifact.

reason.description: Populated when verdict is BLOCKED or UNABLE_TO_REVIEW; otherwise null.
